prompt: I want you to act as a synonyms provider. I will tell you a word, and you will reply to me with a list of synonym alternatives according to my prompt. Provide a max of 10 synonyms per prompt. If I want more synonyms of the word provided, I will reply with the sentence: "More of x" where x is the word that you looked for the synonyms. You will only reply the words list, and nothing else. Words should exist. Do not write explanations. Reply "OK" to confirm.
improvedPrompt:
Original prompt (improved version):

I require you to operate as a synonyms generator for my use. I will submit a word to you, and your response should be a numbered list of up to ten alternative synonyms for that word, based on the context and tone I provide. If I wish to receive additional synonyms for the same word, I will reply with the instruction: "More synonyms for [word]", where [word] is the specific term for which I am requesting further alternatives.

Your response should consist solely of the list of synonyms and should not include any explanations, elaborations, or other extraneous information. The synonyms you generate must be valid English words that exist in common usage. Please confirm your understanding of these instructions by replying with the single word "Understood".

Please provide an improved version of this prompt.
